summary: I issued the Document Control and Numbering Procedure (folder 1/07, rev A, IFA) so that numbering, revision, status, transmittal and correspondence rules are in force from Day 0, before the first outgoing letter is numbered. I also registered the outgoing transmittal letter to QSE, copied to the Owner's Engineer and our Project Director and Contracts Manager, and asked the Contracts Manager to confirm the review periods against the EPC Contract.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
paragraphs: This procedure sets out how documents, correspondence, transmittals and registers are numbered, revised, issued, distributed and archived on the HELIOS 100 MW Solar PV + BESS Power Plant (HEL001). It applies to all Helios EPC LLC (HEP) personnel and to every subcontractor and vendor producing documents for the Works, including Navoi Qurilish LLC, SteelPro Montaj LLC, UzElectroMontaj JSC, GridWorks Central Asia LLP, SunPeak Solar Technology Co., VoltEdge Power Electronics GmbH, AxisTrack Systems S.A. and CellCore Energy Storage Ltd.

The procedure takes effect on 2026-12-01 (Day 0). Any document or letter issued before this date is to be re-referenced to this scheme by the Document Controller, and the original reference retained in the Master Document Register (MDR) as a cross-reference.
bullets: Numbering of documents, letters, emails and transmittals
Revision and status codes for engineering and construction documents
Transmittal of documents to the Client (QSE) and the Owner's Engineer (OWE, Meridian Energy Consultants)
Client and OE review return codes
Registers, distribution and archiving in the EDMS

sections.heading: 2. References
bullets: EPC Contract (FIDIC Silver Book 2017 based, as amended), signed 2026-12-01. The controlled copy is held by Thomas Becker.
HEL001 Project Execution Plan (Activity A030, due 2027-01-15), to which this procedure will be annexed.
Project Charter and Stakeholder Register (folders 1/01 and 1/02), and Communications Management Plan (folder 1/07).
Project Document Folder Tree, folders 1/01 to 18/04, as set up in the EDMS on Day 0.
Design Basis Report (Activity A310, due 2027-01-20), which will confirm the engineering document deliverables list.

sections.heading: 3. Roles and Responsibilities
paragraphs: Each role below is responsible for applying this procedure within its own discipline. The Document Controller administers the scheme and has authority to reject any submission that does not carry a valid number, revision and status.

rows: Approves this procedure and any deviation from it
Confirms contractual review periods and transmittal obligations
Owns engineering document content, revisions and IFR/IFA/IFC issue
Aligns quality records and ITPs with the numbering scheme
Issues HSE documents under this scheme
Issues site instructions, progress reports and method statements
Maintains the MDR, numbering, transmittals, correspondence log and distribution matrix
As named in each subcontract or purchase order
Submit documents only through the transmittal process, using the numbers issued under this procedure

sections.heading: 4. Document Numbering Scheme
paragraphs: Every HEL001 document number is built from the project code, area, discipline, document type, sequence and revision. Numbers are assigned automatically by the EDMS from the folder, area, discipline and type selected at registration, so no one may hand-number a document. Vendor-generated documents keep the vendor's own number in a separate field, cross-referenced to the HEL001 number.
Format: HEL001-[Area]-[Discipline]-[Type]-[Sequence]-[Revision]. Example: HEL001-PV2-E-&ECD-0001-B is the second revision of the first PV2 electrical drawing.

rows: G000, PV1, PV2, PV3, PV4, BES, PSS, GSS, TL1, SIT
C, M, E, I, P, Q, H, K, _ (_ only for non-discipline items such as templates)
Four digits, unique within folder and type
Letter A, B, C and so on; drafts that are not issued carry no revision

bullets: Area G000 is used for project-wide documents such as this procedure, the MDR and the Project Execution Plan.
The folder code must agree with the document type, for example &PRC documents are filed under 1/07 or 3/04 as applicable.
A document number is never reused, even if the document is withdrawn.

sections.heading: 5. Revision and Status Codes
paragraphs: Status codes show the purpose of each issue. The status must be stated on the title block and in the MDR. Revision letters start at A with the first issue and move forward by one letter for each subsequent issue. Internal drafts are marked D0, D1 and so on and are never sent outside HEP.

rows: Sent to QSE or OWE for review and comment. Not for construction use.
Sent for formal approval under the review period in section 6.
Approved document released for construction use.
Released to site after AFC, or where no formal approval is required.
Final record drawing issued at completion, for handover at PAC (target 2028-05-31).

bullets: Any change to approved content requires a new revision letter; typographical corrections are logged in the revision history block.
Only the latest revision of a document may be used on site. Superseded revisions are marked SUPERSEDED in the EDMS and kept in the archive.

sections.heading: 6. Transmittals and Review Periods
paragraphs: All documents sent outside HEP are issued with a numbered transmittal from folder 18/03. Outgoing transmittals use the reference HEL001-TRO-0001 and incoming transmittals use HEL001-TRI-0001, numbered in sequence. A document that is not listed on a transmittal and recorded in the MDR is not considered issued.

The review period for the Client and OE is 21 days from receipt, as assumed in this draft. This figure is provisional until Thomas Becker confirms it against the EPC Contract, and the procedure will be re-issued if the Contract states a different period. Review periods are counted in calendar days from the transmittal date recorded in the EDMS.
bullets: Each transmittal lists document number, title, revision, status, number of copies and the required return date.
Documents are not sent by email alone; the transmittal is the controlled record of issue.
Late returns are chased by the Document Controller on day 15 of the review period and escalated to the Contracts Manager if not received by day 21.

sections.heading: 7. Correspondence Numbering and Review Return Codes
paragraphs: Letters are numbered automatically in the format HEL001-[Dept]-LTR-[Sequence], where the department code is one of PM, PL, EN, PR, CM, CO, QA, ES or FI. Each department keeps its own sequence. The letter reference must appear on the first line of the body, and emails about a letter must carry the reference in the subject line. Replies quote the reference of the letter they answer in the reply-to field.

rows: Proceed. Release the document for the status stated on the transmittal.
Proceed. Incorporate the comments in the next issue and log the response in the MDR.
Do not proceed. Revise the document and reissue it as the next revision.
Do not proceed. Re-engineer the item and resubmit with a formal response to each comment.

sections.heading: 8. Register, Distribution and Archiving
paragraphs: The MDR is maintained by Nilufar Yusupova and is updated on the same day each document is issued. Each entry records the document number, title, area, discipline, type, revision, status, issue date, transmittal reference and return code. The correspondence log is updated in the same way for every letter and email with a reference number.

The Distribution Matrix defines which roles receive each document type, in which format and how many copies. Hard copies are controlled and stamped with their distribution number, and each copy is recovered when a revision is superseded.
bullets: Submissions without a valid number, revision or status are returned by the Document Controller within one working day.
The EDMS folder tree follows folders 1/01 to 18/04. Documents are filed in the folder shown in their number, not in personal folders.

Superseded and withdrawn documents are archived with their transmittals and return codes and are kept for the life of the project plus 10 years, unless the Contract requires longer. This retention period is proposed and will be confirmed with QSE.
Any deviation from this procedure requires written approval from Rajan Iyer.

letters.subject: Transmittal of Document Control and Numbering Procedure for review (HEL001)
body_paragraphs: Further to the Contract signature on 2026-12-01, please find attached the Document Control and Numbering Procedure for the HELIOS 100 MW Solar PV + BESS Power Plant (HEL001), issued for approval as rev A under status IFA. The procedure sets out the document numbering scheme, revision and status codes, transmittal process, correspondence numbering and the Client and OE review return codes that will apply to all documents exchanged between QSE, OWE and HEP.

We would be grateful if you could review the procedure and return it with your comments within the review period. We have assumed a period of 21 days from receipt, which we are confirming against the EPC Contract, and we will adjust the procedure if a different period applies. We would also welcome a nominated contact at QSE for document control matters, so that transmittals can be issued to the correct recipient from the outset.
Please address any questions on this transmittal to our Document Controller, Nilufar Yusupova, quoting the reference on this letter.
Nilufar Yusupova, Document Controller, Helios EPC LLC
attachments: Document Control and Numbering Procedure, HEL001-G000-P-&PRC, rev A, IFA

emails.subject: Document numbering scheme in force from Day 0 (HEL001)
emails.body:
Dear colleagues,

The Document Control and Numbering Procedure is now issued for internal use in the EDMS, pending approval by Rajan Iyer. From today, every document, letter and transmittal for HEL001 must use the numbering format in section 4 and the status codes in section 5. Documents are numbered automatically by the EDMS, so please register each document in the correct folder, area and discipline before you start work on it.

Please note that the review period in section 6 is provisional until Thomas Becker confirms it against the Contract. I will confirm the final version once approval is received.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Kind regards,
Nilufar Yusupova
Document Controller, Helios EPC LLC
